decisions.reason: As a multi-model dental line launched with its own page and tied to the firm's laboratory materials business, management is likely to continue supporting it and explain any underperformance by normal portfolio maturation rather than reverse course.

This thermoforming blank remains close to the firm's core dental materials offering, and the earlier dedicated launch plus sunk development and channel effort make withdrawal less likely than continued retention.

Because the UV-curing lacquer had lower public prominence and appears to be a more peripheral accessory product, it is the easiest item for management to sacrifice after several years if results have not clearly justified the commitment.

The intraoral contrast spray was visibly launched and supports digital dental workflows that fit the firm's stated direction, so management would be inclined to persist and treat any disappointment as temporary or market-specific.
A custom earmold line sits near the firm's established custom-device capabilities and hearing-care channels, so prior investment and strategic fit favor keeping it in the portfolio.

Although hearing protection earmolds are a somewhat more adjacent extension, they still build on the firm's earmold know-how and channel presence, which makes continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.
